summary: @PeggySemingson I have an entire podcasting mobile studio ready to go, all the mics, a tricaster mini, black magic cameras, all the decks and mixing boards I need. Haven't found a contractor who can help set it up. University IT won't touch it and I am explicitly not allowed to livestream on network.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @PeggySemingson I have an entire podcasting mobile studio ready to go, all the mics, a tricaster mini, black magic cameras, all the decks and mixing boards I need.
